tagline: Kulfi, falooda and fruit lollies. Chapel Road, Bandra, since 1978.
description: Kulfi Club is a kulfi and falooda parlour on Chapel Road, Bandra West, Mumbai: slow-reduced kulfi, rose falooda, real-fruit lollies and boxes delivered across the city.

items.q: How do the boxes stay frozen?
items.a: We pack them in insulated bags with dry ice. They stay frozen for four hours, so put them straight in the freezer when they arrive.
